Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding refilling prescriptions of inmates released from jails and state correctional facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to refilling prescriptions of inmates released fromjails and state correctional facilities; and amending RCW 69.41.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.41.190 and 2003 1st sp.s. c 29 s 5 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any pharmacist filling a prescription under a state purchasedhealth care program as defined in RCW 41.05.011(2) shall substitute,where identified, a preferred drug for any nonpreferred drug in a giventherapeutic class, unless the endorsing practitioner has indicated onthe prescription that the nonpreferred drug must be dispensed aswritten, or the prescription is for a refill of an antipsychotic,antidepressant, chemotherapy, antiretroviral, or immunosuppressivedrug, in which case the pharmacist shall dispense the prescribednonpreferred drug. As used in this subsection, "refill" includes aprescription authorized by a prescriber for an inmate after the inmateis released from a jail or state correctional facility. (2) When a substitution is made under subsection (1) of this p. 1 HB 3170section, the dispensing pharmacist shall notify the prescribingpractitioner of the specific drug and dose dispensed.
